_purpose: Authoritative Slack ID → person mapping. EVERY report that attributes a message to someone MUST resolve the sender_id through this file. No exceptions.
_roster: Nick's authoritative roster, 2026-07-30. The NINE entries with `kind: "human"` AND `current: true` are the COMPLETE list of people currently at Muso — if a person is not flagged current here, they do not work at Muso, no matter what any other doc, memory file or workflow says. Never grant authority to a non-current person, never route an approval or escalation to one, and never describe one as a colleague in the present tense. Entries for former staff are retained ONLY so historical messages and commits still resolve to a name.
_github: `github` is the person's GitHub login, verified against the Muso-AI org and github.com/users/<login> on 2026-07-30. `null` means no GitHub account is known for them (typically non-engineering roles) — do NOT guess one, and do not assume a Slack handle matches a GitHub login.
_kind: `kind` is "human" or "bot". Non-human identities carry NO `current` field on purpose: `current` is the current-EMPLOYEE predicate, so a consumer filtering on it must never pick up an automation account. Always check `kind == "human"` before treating an entry as a person. Enforced by scripts/validate-shared-config.sh.
